model: UNetV2 architecture, 6-class softmax head (background, EDH, IPH, IVH, SAH, SDH per official BHSD ontology), all layers initialised from v2 except the output layer
training_data: Same 92 BHSD training scans as v1/v2; no test or CQ500 data
sampling: all positive slices + equal random negatives per epoch
loss: cross-entropy (class weights bg 1, lesions 3) + mean soft Dice over 5 lesion classes
checkpoint: final epoch only, no selection on test
inference: argmax over 6 classes, flip TTA, no post-mask; any-ICH = union of lesion classes
primary_endpoints: per-class Dice and volume agreement on BHSD test (96)
per-subtype presence AUC on BHSD test using class volume
external per-subtype AUC on CQ500 (reader majority) using class volume; any-ICH AUC vs v2
